headline: California Tests Foldable Solar Canopy Over Irrigation Canal
meta_description: A 131-foot foldable solar canopy stretches over a California irrigation canal, generating clean power while shading water to reduce evaporation and weed growth.
summary_short: California is testing an innovative foldable solar canopy spanning 131 feet over an irrigation canal, creating clean energy while protecting water resources.
body:
California is testing a foldable solar canopy stretching 131 feet across an irrigation canal just 21 feet wide—a dual-purpose innovation generating clean power while addressing water loss.

The canopy shades the water below, potentially reducing evaporation and slowing weed growth. In a state where water conservation remains critical and renewable energy demand continues to climb, the project demonstrates how infrastructure can serve multiple needs simultaneously.

By combining solar generation with water management, the pilot program explores whether agricultural regions can harness otherwise unused space above canals to produce electricity without consuming additional land or water resources.

Generates clean power while shading water
May reduce evaporation and weed growth
